spec_family.name: New Construction Drywall Ceiling Finish Coat
spec_family.description: Finish coat application (1-2 coats) for primed drywall ceilings in new construction. Applied over cured primer. Ceilings are painted BEFORE walls — NO edge work required. Wall painter establishes the ceiling line. Mirrors SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH structure adapted for overhead work.

includes: Finish coat application (1 or 2 coats depending on QT)
Surface preparation (inspection, dust wipe, sanding per QT)
Ceiling fixture protection (recessed lights, electrical boxes) for spray methods
Lightweight plastic pin-up over window/door openings for spray methods
excludes: Edge work at ceiling-wall boundary (wall painter establishes ceiling line)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier per doctrine. Sheen restricts minimum QT.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2-QT3 = 1 coat flat; QT4 = 2 coats (flat for color OR eggshell or satin); QT5 = 2 coats semi-gloss or gloss

configuration_dimensions.description: Application technique. Spray+backroll uses 18-inch roller per doctrine.
Finish sheen. Higher sheens require higher QT and have application penalty on ceilings.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Flat is standard for ceilings. Satin/semi-gloss require QT4+. Higher sheens are significantly harder on ceilings.

configuration_dimensions.description: Ceiling height classification driving height modifiers
configuration_dimensions.notes: standard (<=9ft), tall (10-12ft), vaulted (13-17ft), cathedral (18ft+). More aggressive than wall height modifiers due to overhead.

quality_sheen_rules.auto_upgrade: If sheen requires higher QT than specified, auto-upgrade QT

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Field Finish Coat
paintable_items.notes: Primary paintable item — ceiling finish paint application. No edge work items — wall painter establishes ceiling line.

protection_items.name: Ceiling Fixture Protection (Lights + Electrical)
protection_items.counting_rules: Source from PS_META.EA.ROOMS_TOTAL; heuristic: 6 recessed lights + 2 ceiling electrical boxes per room
protection_items.notes: Stuff recessed cans and ceiling electrical boxes with paper, tape over face. Verify/apply.

protection_items.name: Window/Door Opening Lightweight Covers
protection_items.notes: Pin lightweight plastic over window and door openings to catch overspray fallout. Verify existing or apply new. Not intricate masking — quick pin-up protection.

variants.notes: Standard NC production — spray+backroll, single coat flat
Premium spray+backroll flat — two coats for colored ceilings. No sheen penalty.
Premium spray+backroll eggshell or satin — two coats. Sheen application penalty applies.
Critical spray+backroll for semi-gloss — two coats, critical prep. Significant sheen penalty.
Economy roller — single coat. No protection items for roll method.
Premium roller flat — two coats. No sheen penalty.
Premium roller eggshell or satin — two coats. Sheen application penalty applies.
Critical roller for semi-gloss — two coats, critical prep. Significant sheen penalty.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Floor area for subfloor vacuum cleanup
Room count for ceiling fixture protection heuristic
Count of window openings for lightweight cover verification/application
Count of door openings for lightweight cover verification/application

protection_zones_required.notes: Ceiling fixtures — recessed lights and electrical boxes
Lightweight plastic pin-up over window and door openings to catch overspray fallout

adjacent_surfaces.notes: NO edge tasks — ceiling painter rolls freely into wall area. Wall painter establishes final ceiling line.

valid_input_states.notes: Ceiling finish requires primed surface (field-primed from ceiling prime spec)

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Full mask required for finished walls — solid tape line at wall-to-ceiling junction with draped plastic along wall. Rare in NC (ceilings before walls) but required for repaint scenarios.
Unfinished walls need no protection — ceiling paint rollover is acceptable

site_condition_rules.effect: Height modifier applies per production.json height_effects. Scaffold/lift setup adds fixed time.
site_condition_rules.notes: Ceilings above 14ft require scaffold or lift, significantly impacting all overhead tasks

site_condition_rules.effect: Occupied spaces may restrict spray methods due to overspray and fumes. May force roll-only.
site_condition_rules.notes: NC is typically unoccupied, but phased occupancy can occur in multi-unit projects

site_condition_rules.effect: Poor ventilation restricts spray methods and slows all work.
site_condition_rules.notes: Enclosed spaces without HVAC running require additional ventilation setup for spray work

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Ceilings painted BEFORE walls in NC production
sequencing_notes.edge_work: NONE REQUIRED — ceiling painter can roll onto wall area. Wall painter establishes final ceiling line.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Protect ceiling fixtures → Verify/apply opening covers → Apply finish coat(s) → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: QT4/QT5 only: Coat 1 → Light sand → Coat 2
sequencing_notes.masking_persistence: Opening covers STAY IN PLACE for wall painting — they persist across NC phases

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for NC drywall ceiling finish. Generated from brief specs/_backlog/SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_FINISH/brief.md. Key features: NO edge work (wall painter establishes ceiling line), fixture_covers and opening_cover_lightweight protection zones, ceiling-specific overhead rate reductions (15-20% slower than walls), height modifiers per Modifier_Registry, sheen application penalties for eggshell (1.18x) and semi-gloss (1.43x) on ceilings.
